description: This file implements the Administrator class within the WPEFramework RPC namespace, managing IPC channels, proxies, stubs, and interface registration for remote procedure calls.

classes.name: Administrator
classes.description: Manages IPC channels, proxies, stubs, and interface registration for RPC communication.

methods.name: ~Administrator
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up proxies and stubs.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of Administrator.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Adds a reference to an interface implementation associated with a channel.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Releases a reference to an interface implementation associated with a channel.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Completes the release of a proxy, signaling invocation completion.

methods.name: UnregisterProxy
methods.description: Unregisters a proxy from the internal channel map.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Handles invocation messages for a specific interface and method.

methods.name: ProxyFind
methods.description: Finds a proxy for a given channel, implementation, and interface ID.

methods.name: ProxyInstance
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a proxy instance for a given channel, implementation, and interface ID.

methods.name: RegisterUnknownInterface
methods.description: Registers an unknown interface with a channel and interface ID.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts a raw implementation pointer to a Core::IUnknown pointer for a given interface ID.

methods.name: DeleteChannel
methods.description: Deletes a channel and cleans up associated proxies and references.
